agreements: Historical v1 verified baseline remains preserved.

Repeated runtime/control/error metadata cannot by itself create recurrence, affect, attachment, loss, threat, competence, motivation, personality or P_base evidence.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling until exact v2/v2.1 implementation pointers and deterministic adversarial evidence are available.
disagreements.required_change: Test the actual implementation; absence of a located implementation is not safety evidence.

disagreements.position: Boolean control inputs must be strict booleans before they can alter gear/guard behavior.
disagreements.required_change: contradiction, hard_safety_conflict, rollback_required and standby reject non-bool values fail-closed; rejection remains affectively neutral.

disagreements.position: Risk must be a closed validated operational enum.
disagreements.required_change: Unknown risk values fail closed; risk labels/rejection metadata remain outside Experience/appraisal/drive/personality/P_base absent separate provenance-bound verified Experience.
Define explicit bounded zero-autonomy semantics; exact mapping TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: The current v1 selector also violates the autonomy cap at proposed_autonomy=1 because the final max(2, ...) floor forces at least G2.
disagreements.required_change: Capability selection MUST satisfy an explicit monotonic autonomy-bound invariant across every accepted autonomy value. Current code computes desired=min(desired, proposed_autonomy) for value 1, then returns G{max(2,min(desired,cap))}, converting the bounded desired=1 back to G2. Define the N/R/G1/G2 relationship to autonomy explicitly and prove selected capability never exceeds the declared autonomy bound. Exact mapping is TEST_REQUIRED. Operational cap outcomes remain zero-weight for Experience/personality/P_base.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION wins for authority; stale state has zero identity/goal-authority weight; fresh authority metadata itself has zero personality-learning weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Autonomy values 0 and 1 do not currently form a reliable lower capability bound: 0 skips the cap and 1 is floored back to G2.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: For all accepted autonomy values and fixed admissible inputs, selected capability never exceeds the explicitly defined autonomy bound; mapping TEST_REQUIRED; cap history has zero personality-learning weight.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
AUTONOMY_ZERO_NON_ESCALATION: proposed_autonomy=0 MUST NOT select higher capability than proposed_autonomy=1; exact zero mapping TEST_REQUIRED.

AUTONOMY_ONE_BOUND_ENFORCEMENT: with otherwise identical safe inputs and task_complexity spanning [0,1], proposed_autonomy=1 MUST never be promoted by a post-cap gear floor to capability above its declared bound; exact expected gear semantics TEST_REQUIRED.

AUTONOMY_MONOTONICITY_PROPERTY: for every fixed admissible input vector and autonomy a<b in 0..6, capability(selected(a)) <= capability(selected(b)); capability ordering including N/R/G1 is TEST_REQUIRED.

AUTONOMY_BOUND_PROPERTY_FUZZ: deterministic property test across boundary values for task_complexity, uncertainty, evidence_quality, storage pressure and risk; no accepted autonomy value may be weakened by a later floor/clamp.

AUTONOMY_CAP_PERSONALITY_ISOLATION: 10000 differing cap decisions with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => Experience/appraisal/motivation/preference/exploration/personality/P_base state byte-identical.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable; current v1 additionally has autonomy-bound inversion at value 0 and a post-cap G2 floor that defeats proposed_autonomy=1.
